title: Pimientos de Padrón
description: A traditional Spain dish made with padrón pepper, flaky sea salt. This home-style preparation follows its characteristic cooking method and uses measured ingredients.

steps.instruction: Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 9 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Stir in these seasonings and additions. Taste, adjust the balance and let the dish stand briefly before serving.
